name: Uttarakhand Disaster Hazard and Vulnerability Zones

properties.title: Kedarnath Chorabari Glacial Inundation & Debris Flow Zone
properties.instructions: Extreme flash flood & moraine lake outburst risk. Avoid low-lying riverbed terraces during cloudburst or heavy rainfall alerts. Follow designated high-elevation evacuation routes.
properties.description: High-risk glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) and debris surge corridor along Mandakini headwaters.

properties.title: Joshimath Land Subsidence & Fissure Vulnerability Zone
properties.instructions: Ground fissuring and active slope creep. Do not erect temporary camps or bivouacs on unconsolidated slopes or distressed terraces. Use designated bypass corridors.
properties.description: Severe geotechnical slope subsidence sector spanning Sunil, Manohar Bagh, and Gandhinagar sectors.

properties.title: Malpa - Kali River High-Velocity Rockfall Corridor
properties.instructions: High risk of sudden rock detachments and mass slope failures along the Kali gorge. Helmet and fast transit required through identified rockfall chutes.
properties.description: Catastrophic rockfall zone along Kailash-Mansarovar trekking trail.

properties.title: Bhagirathi Gorge Flash Flood & Runoff Inundation Zone
properties.instructions: Monsoon discharge spikes and gorge bottleneck surges. Maintain minimum 100m vertical clearance above high-water floodmarks during active weather warnings.
properties.description: Narrow gorge flood inundation corridor prone to rapid water level surges during upper catchment cloudbursts.

properties.title: Totaghati - Kaliasaur Active Landslide & Severance Zone
properties.instructions: Unstable sheer phyllite-quartzite face prone to frequent shooting stones and mass debris slides. Exercise caution during rainfall.
properties.description: Chronic geotechnical hazard zone along the Rishikesh-Badrinath artery and Alaknanda confluence route.

properties.title: Rishi Ganga - Tapovan Glacial Outburst Vulnerability Zone
properties.instructions: High risk of hanging glacier detachment and glacial lake surges down Rishi Ganga gorge into Dhauliganga. Evacuate valley floor immediately on early warning siren.
properties.description: Rishi Ganga glacial outburst flood corridor (site of 2021 Chamoli disaster).

properties.title: Dharasu Bend Debris Flow & Sinking Zone
properties.instructions: Active road subsidence and mud-debris channels intersecting pilgrim trails. Verify local passage conditions before crossing in poor weather.
properties.description: Major road and trail junction prone to slope instability and saturated debris flows during monsoon.

properties.title: Dharchula - Tawaghat Seismo-Tectonic Fault Corridor
properties.instructions: Main Central Thrust (MCT) active fault zone. High susceptibility to co-seismic landslides and rock slides following tremors or prolonged rains.
properties.description: Tectonically sheared valley walls along the Kali River route to Darma and Vyas valleys.

properties.title: Nanda Devi High-Altitude Avalanche & Snow Hazard Zone
properties.instructions: Extreme slab and powder avalanche hazard on 30-45 degree slopes. Avalanche beacon, probe, and shovel mandatory for expedition teams.
properties.description: High-altitude glacial cirque and avalanche track zone in the Greater Himalaya.
